Title: Verify that a merchant can view a list of all incoming transactions on the Transactions page

Step Expected: A list of all incoming transactions for the merchant's account is displayed

Title: Verify that a newly completed payment appears in the merchant's transaction list after refreshing or reopening the Transactions page

Step Action: Have a customer complete a new payment to this merchant
Refresh or reopen the Transactions page
Step Expected: The new transaction now appears in the list, without further delay

Title: Verify that a merchant can open a completed transaction and view its customer payment details

Step Expected: Customer name, payment method, reference ID, and payment channel are all shown

Title: Verify that a merchant can open a pending transaction and see its status without error or failure details

Step Expected: Transaction detail view opens, showing status "Pending"

Step Action: Observe for any error or failure-reason field
Step Expected: None is shown, since the transaction has neither completed nor failed

Title: Verify that a merchant can view transactions originating from different payment channels in the same list

Step Expected: Both transactions are shown together in the same list
Each shows the correct payment channel (e.g. "QR Code" vs. "Payment Plugin") for that transaction

Title: Verify that a failed transaction's detail view shows the error or reason for failure

Step Expected: Transaction detail view opens, showing status "Failed"

Step Action: Observe the detail view for failure information
Step Expected: An error message or reason for the failure is displayed

Title: Verify that a merchant cannot view another merchant's transactions

Step Action: View the Transactions list as Merchant A
Step Expected: Only Merchant A's transactions are shown

Step Action: Attempt to access Merchant B's transaction detail directly (e.g. via a guessed or manipulated transaction/reference ID in the URL, if applicable)
Step Expected: Access is denied; Merchant B's transaction data is not returned or displayed

Title: Verify that an unauthenticated user cannot access the Transactions page

Step Action: Attempt to navigate directly to the Transactions page URL
Step Expected: The user is redirected to login/authentication and is not shown any transaction data

Title: Verify that the Transactions page displays a clear empty state when the merchant has no transactions yet

Step Expected: A clear "no transactions yet" empty state is shown, not an error or a blank/broken page

Title: Verify that a transaction's status updates from Pending to Completed when viewed again after the underlying payment completes

Step Action: Wait for the underlying payment to complete, then refresh or reopen the Transactions page

Title: Verify that filtering and export controls are not present on the Transactions page for Release 1

Step Action: Review the Transactions page for any filter controls (date, channel, amount) or export/download controls (CSV, PDF)
Step Expected: None are present — this page is read-only list + balance only for Release 1
